calls.statement:
-- Check both UTC and Helsinki date counts
SELECT 
  'UTC date' AS date_method,
  COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS date_value
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'Helsinki date' AS date_method,
  COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
  CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS date_value
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
